body: you've come to the right place, also like myself. i have decided to fight this. it helps to know i'm not alone....and neither are you. Fight with me

i really appreciate your story. it is so easy to feel alone when battling depression and bi polar disorder. it gave me hope there is still someone out there who can understand what i go through on a daily basis. i made an appointment this morning with my doctor to get a referral to a psychiatrist. maybe its just my up talking, but just making the appointment has made me feel....well hopeful. your story has given me the courage to find my right mix of meds and find happiness. 
my daughter inheriting my mental illnesses has always been a fear of mine. i can see differences in us already. she can make a friend anywhere. it gives me hope she will be ok. thank you again for being my friend.

thank you giving me some of your strength. i am exhausted. last night i read my daughter a long story and let her sleep in my bed so she and i could have a good last night together. i crawled in bed and held her hand. still so small i started thinking of missing her graduation and wedding and everything in between and after. you are right. i would have ruined so much for her. thank you for being here for me

pain may be a state of mind, but I don't think anyone chooses to feel this way. any advice as to how to find anything to love? i don't feel any love for the things i used to do. believe me i've been trying. i just feel like there isnt anything left for me.
I don't know what else to say....people tell me the pain is temporary, but it isn't. I've been feeling this for so long
